item.title: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as fears of escalating Houthi attacks rise
item.description: The State Department is ordering some diplomats and the families of U.S. government employees to leave Saudi Arabia

item.title: Sister of American Stephen Hubbard says he's in disbelief following release by Russia
item.description: The younger sister of Stephen Hubbard, the American who was freed after spending more than four years in a Russian prison, says he was in disbelief about his release

item.title: Suspected gunman in National Guard shooting in DC is charged with multiple firearms offenses
item.description: A man accused of wounding a Georgia National Guard member in Washington, D.C., who tried to help break up a fight has been charged with multiple gun crimes

item.title: Over 500 in South Africa sickened in outbreak linked to poor water quality
item.description: Over 500 people in South Africa have fallen ill from a gastrointestinal illness linked to poor water quality in two cities

item.title: Arizona woman's 3-year wait for an intestine shows the US organ transplant system's complexity
item.description: A car crash destroyed a 25-year-old Phoenix woman's small intestine, leaving her dependent on IV nutrition and often too sick to get out of bed

item.title: Chemical tank leak in Ohio forces evacuations as city allows plume to vent
item.description: A chemical tank rupture in Toledo, Ohio, forced hundreds of residents to evacuate and others to shelter in place due to the potentially toxic leak

item.title: Iran says 7 oil tankers attacked in the Strait of Hormuz as fears grow of a return to war
item.description: Iran's government says seven oil tankers have caught fire or been damaged in the strategic Strait of Hormuz

item.title: Trump-allied Colombian president removes art exhibits he deems communist, sparking protests
item.description: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella says he is leading a cultural shift by removing exhibits from the National Museum

item.title: Carney says Trump’s tariffs hurt Americans as US Embassy alleges Canadian interference
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney says that U.S. President Donald Trump’s tariffs have raised costs for American families and upended decades of trade as he unveiled a $6.2 billion plan to protect Canada’s manufacturing heartland

item.title: Video game developer BioWare shuts down, next 'Mass Effect' canceled amid broader layoffs at EA
item.description: Video game publisher Electronic Arts is shutting down the popular and influential game development studio BioWare after more than three decades

item.title: Meta ordered to pay New Mexico $25 billion for deceiving users about privacy on Facebook
item.description: A state judge has ordered Meta to pay New Mexico $25 billion for deceiving users about privacy on Facebook, marking the biggest fine ever against the tech giant

item.title: Some websites go dark as operators address an AI-detected flaw in a web programming language
item.description: The FBI’s cyber division warned Wednesday about the discovery of two “critical vulnerabilities” in PHP, a widely used programming language that powers many websites and web applications

item.title: Tesla's Q3 profit drops as it prepares for possible merger with Musk's other public company, SpaceX
item.description: Tesla posted a drop in profit for the latest quarter as it prepares for a possible merger with Elon Musk’s other big business, SpaceX

item.title: A SpaceX-Tesla megamerger could benefit both companies and Elon Musk's personal fortune
item.description: Stocks of Elon Musk's two biggest companies are rising Wednesday after he suggested a combination was in the works to form a trillion dollar colossus in possibly the biggest deal ever

item.title: Ukraine's strikes on Russian data centers disrupt key services and derail AI research
item.description: Russia prides itself on its digital advances — from an extensive e-commerce services sector to ambitious plans for developing artificial intelligence
